scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist/en/projects dist/ja/projects && cp -r includes dist/ && for f in src/en/*.md; do base=${f##*/}; pandoc "$f" -t html -s -o "dist/en/${base%.md}.html" --include-after-body=includes/mermaid-init.html; done && for f in src/en/projects/*.md; do base=${f##*/}; pandoc "$f" -t html -s -o "dist/en/projects/${base%.md}.html" --include-after-body=includes/mermaid-init.html; done && for f in src/ja/*.md; do base=${f##*/}; pandoc "$f" -t html -s -o "dist/ja/${base%.md}.html" --include-after-body=includes/mermaid-init.html; done && for f in src/ja/projects/*.md; do base=${f##*/}; pandoc "$f" -t html -s -o "dist/ja/projects/${base%.md}.html" --include-after-body=includes/mermaid-init.html; done && echo '<meta http-equiv="refresh" content="0; url=en/index.html" />' > dist/index.html
